bio.text: Danielle Bass represents Senate District 18 in the Hawaii State Senate, covering Central Oʻahu communities including Mililani.

Bass served on the Mililani Neighborhood Board for 19 years, five of them as chair, and was Hawaiʻi's State Sustainability Coordinator in the Office of Planning and Sustainable Development for nearly a decade.
Bass is a graduate of Mililani High School and holds a Master of Urban and Regional Planning and a Bachelor of Arts in Political Science from the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.
